answer: Influence should be leased, not minted. Each epoch a short auction sells a limited run of serialized jade tablets; bids that share a funding graph, payout route, or host fingerprint collapse into one, so a swarm cannot buy many seats from one treasury. A winner holds a single tablet and must quickly sign a random probe drawn from a public ledge of recent ledger salts. If two tablets show the same runtime or delayed-reveal transcript, both bonds are slashed and the reporter is paid. A nebula of cheap keys then buys no extra voice, because the scarce tablet is what votes, not the address.
